Asli himmat darr ko jaan-na hai.
Duniya ko jeetne se pehle khud par vijay pao.
Himmat darr ka hona nahi, usse ladna hai.
Restraint mein power—silence.
Sahas woh kala hai jab sirf tumhein pata ho ki tum dar rahe ho.
Sabse strong jawab restraint hai.
Asli taqat rooh ki khamoshi mein hai.
Shaant zindagi chhoti nahi hoti.
Zubaan talwar hai; khamoshi uska sheath.
Sabse strong jawab kabhi kabhi khamoshi.
Necessary ho to alone khade rehna courage.
Thoughts ke beech breath—silence.
Himmat nidar hai.
Patience wait karne ki ability nahi—wait ke dauran bhi achha attitude banaye rakhne ki ability hai.
Himmat growth choose karti hai.
Courage contagious hota hai.
Grit lachila-pan hai.
Strong actions hi sabse loud bolte hain.
Courage measure hota hai jo aap karte.
